name: Haption
description: Haption SA is a robotics company founded in 2001 in Soulgé-sur-Ouette, France, as a spin-off from the French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission (CEA). The company manufactures 6-degree-of-freedom force-feedback haptic interfaces, including the [Virtuose 6D](/robot/haption_virtuoso) series used in teleoperation and medical simulation.
